## Selected Work

### Physics-Informed Underwater Image Enhancement

My M.Tech. thesis investigated a physics-informed diffusion framework for enhancing underwater images under high-turbidity conditions. The work combined computer vision, generative modelling, physical priors, and experimental evaluation.

[Read the NCC 2025 paper](https://doi.org/10.1109/NCC63735.2025.10983784) · [Read the technical article on Medium](https://medium.com/@akcoolkmr/physics-deep-learning-why-physical-priors-still-matter-in-the-age-of-big-models-9c220710e355)

<span class="project-tag">Computer Vision</span>

:::

### Image Similarity Search

Built during my FrugalX internship, this project implements an end-to-end visual retrieval workflow using learned image features, Milvus for vector indexing and similarity search, and MySQL for mapping vector IDs back to image records.

[View the repository on GitHub](https://github.com/Harper2123/Image-Similarity-Search)

<span class="project-tag">Visual Retrieval</span>
<span class="project-tag">Milvus</span>
<span class="project-tag">MySQL</span>
<span class="project-tag">Python</span>
:::

::: project-card
### WQU Applied AI Lab

A consolidated body of six capstone projects covering computer vision and generative-AI problems, including image classification, object detection, face recognition, and GAN-based image generation. I keep this as evidence of breadth and earlier applied learning rather than as a single flagship project.

[View the repository on GitHub](https://github.com/Harper2123/wqu-applied-ai-lab)

## Earlier Learning & Project History

The projects below reflect earlier coursework, capstones, simulations, and exploratory work. They remain part of my learning history, but they are intentionally not foregrounded as current flagship work.

### Computer Vision & Generative AI

- **Wildlife Conservation in Côte d'Ivoire** — image classification for camera-trap wildlife data
- **Crop Disease Detection in Uganda** — transfer learning for crop-disease classification
- **Traffic Monitoring in Bangladesh** — object detection on traffic video
- **Medical Data Generation in Spain** — GAN experiments with an interactive Streamlit application
- **Celebrity Sightings in India** — face detection and recognition using MTCNN and Inception-ResNet
- **Social Media Meme Generator** — Stable Diffusion-based image generation experiment
- **Live Twitter Sentiment Analysis** — NLP sentiment pipeline and Streamlit dashboard

### Time Series, Statistics & Finance

- **Air Quality in Nairobi** — ARMA time-series forecasting with MongoDB-backed data
- **Volatility Forecasting in India** — GARCH volatility modelling with API and SQLite integration
- **A/B Testing at WorldQuant University** — chi-square testing and ETL/application work
- **NBA MVP Predictor** — historical sports-data scraping and predictive modelling

### Classical ML & Analytics

- **Bankruptcy in Poland** — tree-based models for imbalanced classification
- **Earthquake Damage in Nepal** — logistic regression and decision trees with bias analysis
- **Customer Segmentation in the US** — k-means clustering and PCA
- **Housing in Mexico** — exploratory analysis of real-estate data
- **Apartment Sales in Buenos Aires** — linear regression with preprocessing pipelines

### Data, SQL & Business Analytics

- **Little Lemon Restaurant Database** — relational database design, stored procedures, Python, and Tableau
- **Banking Trends Analysis** — Python and SQL data-analysis workflows
- **Work-Related Fatality Analysis** — Python-to-MySQL data pipeline and SQL analysis
- **Zomato Restaurant Data Analysis** — Python, Excel, and SQL analysis
- **BCG, Quantium, and TCS simulations** — earlier business/data-analysis exercises

The full repository history remains available on [GitHub](https://github.com/Harper2123).
